title: The spec introduces complex decision gates—especially evidence-tier promotion/demotion and sweep execution/deg
text: The spec introduces complex decision gates—especially evidence-tier promotion/demotion and sweep execution/degradation—but provides only distributed prose and enum transitions. REVIEW.md requires a consistency matrix or explicit pointer covering gate inputs, allowed outcomes, required next actions, mirror surfaces, and examples. Add that matrix coverage; the PR description's not-applicable rationale incorrectly limits this requirement to development-workflow protocols.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 3d317ae, 9 commits later. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
